verdict: Yes. Fundoo Labs from Vadodara pitched DIY science and sensory toys on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Parents and schools want hands-on STEM learning, and kits sell well in schools, gifting and online.
angle: Science kits, sensory toys and experiments make learning fun for children. Schools and learning centres buy in bulk. Safety standards (BIS toy certification) apply, and good instructions are essential.
